title: Entity link
responsibility: Provides a real explorer link with in-app navigation for plain clicks.

inputs.name: EntityLink.to
inputs.description: Explorer destination passed unchanged to nav.href(to) for the anchor address and to nav.go(to) after a plain click. This component does not validate or transform the location.

inputs.name: EntityLink.nav
inputs.description: Host-supplied navigation object with required route, href, and go members and an optional source callback. This component calls href(to) while rendering and go(to) after a plain click; it does not read route or source.

inputs.name: EntityLink.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name forwarded to aria-label when the visible text alone does not say where the link leads. When omitted, its value is undefined and this component adds no fallback label.

inputs.name: EntityLink.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet that provides the visible anchor content and is invoked when the link renders. This component supplies no fallback content.

outputs.name: EntityLink
outputs.description: Renders an hx-a anchor with href from nav.href(to), the optional aria-label, remaining anchor attributes, data-harness-component="harness-entity-link", and the children snippet. A plain click prevents default and calls nav.go(to), while modified or non-primary clicks retain browser behavior; callback and content errors are not caught.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors thrown by nav.href(to), nav.go(to), or the children snippet propagate because this component catches none of them.
